description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing company filings data from TMX, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and asynchronous data fetching logic.

classes.name: TmxCompanyFilingsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for TMX company filings, including start and end dates, with validation for the symbol.

classes.name: TmxCompanyFilingsData
classes.description: Represents individual company filing data with fields for description and size, and alias mappings.

classes.name: TmxCompanyFilingsFetcher
classes.description: Asynchronous fetcher class for retrieving TMX company filings data, including query transformation, data extraction, and transformation methods.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a validated query object, setting default date ranges and formatting the symbol.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches filings data from TMX endpoint over multiple date chunks, handling retries and sorting results.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into validated TmxCompanyFilingsData instances.
